title: Jets' Breece Hall looking to continue 'proving' himself after contract extension: 'It makes me more hungry'

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Jets' Breece Hall looking to continue 'proving' himself after contract extension: 'It makes me more hungry'
sources.description: Now heading his fifth season in the NFL, Jets RB Breece Hall wants to keep proving he deserves to be in the position he's earned.
